[[File:Sanguine crawler icon.png|left]]
'''Sanguine crawlers''' are [[Slayer monsters]] found at the [[Blighted Cave]] in [[Havenhythe]] requiring level 28 Slayer to damage.

After 5 auto attacks, the Sanguine crawler will say {{RSChat|*schluurp*}} and perform a [[Sanguine]] type damage, floor-targeted magic attack that deals 1,114 damage through protection prayers to the player if they are standing on it when it bursts. This damage can be reduced by [[tank armour]] or the effects of an [[antisanguine potion]] or its [[Super antisanguine|superior]] [[Extreme antisanguine|variants]].

Sanguine crawlers take 50% increased damage from [[havensilver weapons]]. Only the main hand weapon or ammunition needs to be havensilver to deal increased damage.

===Getting there===
* Fairy ring {{Fairy code|BKS}} and walk north-east
* [[Wendlewick Teleport]] to Marigold Farm (requires [[Wiz Kid]]) and run east
* [[War's Retreat]] portal for [[Silverquill, the Dreadhog|Silverquill]], and exit the cave
* Travel Canoe from Burnt Lobster Tavern to Farm then run south
